<!--
Thanks for contributing. Editorial fixes can come straight here; challenges to
the reasoning are usually better as an issue first, so we can agree on the
direction before you spend time writing.
-->

## What changed, and why

<!-- The field reviewers actually read. A sentence or two is plenty. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Editorial — typo, formatting, broken link, clearer phrasing
- [ ] Correction — a fact, figure, or citation was wrong
- [ ] Evidence — added or updated a source
- [ ] Design — changes a mechanism, principle, or conclusion
- [ ] Repository — CI, templates, metadata, tooling

## Related issue

<!-- e.g. Closes #12. Write "none" for a standalone editorial fix. -->

## For corrections and evidence

**Source:**
<!-- Link or citation, with a date. -->

**Does this change a conclusion?**
<!-- If yes, say which one and where — the reasoning may need updating elsewhere. -->

## For design changes

**Which principle does this follow from?**
<!-- §4 lists thirteen, each with its derivation. If it follows from none of
     them, that may itself be the more interesting discussion. -->

**What's the failure mode?**
<!-- The design's credibility rests on §14 being honest. If your addition has a
     cost or a way it breaks, name it here so it can be written down. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I've read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] The change is focused — one concern per pull request
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated under `## [Unreleased]` (skip for typos)
- [ ] Markdown lints cleanly (`npx markdownlint-cli2 "**/*.md" "#node_modules"`)
- [ ] I agree my contribution is licensed under [CC BY 4.0](../blob/main/LICENSE)
